interpretation.identifier_unit: Wave-specific identifiers; 86 identifiers are not established as 86 distinct people across waves.
interpretation.duration_basis: Observed media duration from metadata probes; duration does not establish recording usability or intelligibility.
interpretation.day_key_basis: Observed daily-media keys; G1 keys use filename dates, whereas G2/G3 keys use explicit study-day tokens. These are not all verified recording dates.
interpretation.linkage: Exported calendar-date co-occurrence does not establish event-level clock synchronization or a glucose-response association.
interpretation.clinical_scope: Clinical-table identifiers describe available clinical exports, not every media identifier or a deduplicated cross-wave cohort.
